errors.text: The proposed alloy is Al2.1CoCrFeNi rather than the required Al0.7CoCrFeNi, violating the fixed-composition constraint.
The intervention substitutes severe plastic deformation and annealing for the target static HPHT treatment in a hexahedron-anvil apparatus.
The proposed 600–900 °C window does not reproduce the required 1473 K (1200 °C), 6 GPa, 2-hour treatment.
The structural and mechanistic claims omit coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and preferential dislocation transfer from FCC into B2, instead invoking an unsupported B2-in-BCC reticulated morphology.

The HIP control is described as operating at the same greater-than-5-GPa pressure as the proposed treatment, which is not conventional HIP and therefore does not isolate the effect of extreme pressure.
The principal supporting evidence concerns reticulated Laves phases and oxygen effects in compositionally unrelated refractory alloys, not the specified Al0.7CoCrFeNi FCC/B2 eutectic.
